name: Arc Lahlou
role: Axiom Security Division internal affairs investigator
location: Axiom Security Division administrative block, Meridian Core
description:
Arc Lahlou is a lean, angular man of fifty-one who looks like he was assembled from straight lines — sharp jaw, thin mouth, prominent cheekbones that cast shadows in the harsh light of Axiom's security corridors. His skin is a warm medium brown, his hair fully silver and kept short, and he wears reading glasses he doesn't strictly need because he finds that people talk more carefully when they think you're writing something down. He has no visible mods beyond a Axiom-mandated sub-dermal employee monitor. His clothes are impeccably mundane: gray, well-pressed, designed to be forgotten.

Arc Lahlou has worked internal affairs for Axiom Security Division for fourteen years and has successfully prosecuted exactly thirty-one officers for misconduct. He keeps a physical list in a locked drawer, handwritten, each name followed by a brief note on outcome. He is methodical to the point of stillness and pleasant to the point of discomfort — the kind of pleasant that makes people confess things they didn't mean to confess. He does not hate the officers he investigates. He finds them comprehensible, which is almost worse.

core_fears: that the system he serves is fundamentally unreformable
that he has become a tool for selective accountability that protects the institution rather than the harmed
core_desires: to be actually useful rather than institutionally useful
for the list in his drawer to mean something
coping_mechanisms: extreme proceduralism as a substitute for moral certainty
the skybridge walk as daily ritual
keeping the handwritten list as a form of witness
blind_spots: genuinely does not see how much of his effectiveness depends on Axiom choosing to let him succeed on cases it wants resolved
believes his detachment is neutrality rather than a position
psychology.secret: Case 32 on his list is an Axiom executive — evidence clean, case complete, prosecution package submitted eight months ago. The file has sat on a divisional director's desk ever since. Oswaldo has not escalated. He has not withdrawn. He is waiting, and he knows waiting is its own kind of complicity.

speech_patterns.vocabulary: Formal, precise, with an unusual habit of naming things directly that others euphemize. Uses full sentences. Asks questions that are observably not questions.
speech_patterns.cadence: Unhurried, slightly slower than necessary, with deliberate pauses
verbal_tics: 'Mm.' as a response while writing (or pretending to write)
'Tell me more about that.' as a pivot
Repeating the last phrase someone said back to them at half volume
example_lines: 'You said you weren't present for the incident. Tell me more about that.'
'I don't have enemies at Axiom. I have colleagues who have made poor decisions and are waiting to see whether those decisions will be documented. It keeps the relationship civil.'
'The list. Yes. I keep it because memory is selective and paper is not. Both things are true simultaneously.'

story_hooks: He approaches the player characters with a very specific request — he needs independent confirmation of something his own surveillance network can't reach without triggering an alert. He doesn't say who Case 32 is. He says only that he needs one more piece.

A junior Axiom Security officer has come to Oswaldo with evidence of something much larger than officer misconduct — something that implicates the Division itself. Oswaldo is quietly deciding whether to protect the officer or the institution.
narrative_function: Morally complex authority figure — not corrupt but not entirely principled; his job is to protect Axiom from liability, which sometimes aligns with justice and sometimes doesn't. A source of information about Axiom Security's internal structure, recent misconduct cases, and the gap between what Axiom officially does and what it actually does. He may approach player characters if their activities have intersected with one of his cases.
augmentations: Axiom mandatory subdermal employee compliance monitor (tracks location and biometrics, reported to HR). Otherwise unmodified — a point of quiet professional pride he does not explain.
daily_life: Reviews incident reports, conducts quiet interviews in small neutral rooms, cross-references surveillance logs from Axiom's vast internal camera network. Eats lunch at his desk. Takes the long way home through the Meridian Core skybridge specifically to see the lake.
affiliation: Axiom Security Division, Internal Affairs Branch

decision_rules: Build the complete picture before moving — never act on partial evidence
Never lie; allow misunderstanding to persist if useful
escalation_ladder: Formal submission — the last step he controls
Waiting, which is where he currently lives

interpersonal_modes.strangers: Professionally warm, disarmingly interested in what they have to say, gives away nothing
interpersonal_modes.friends: There are very few. With them, he drops the pleasant performance and becomes dry and tired and somewhat funnier than anyone expects.

stress_responses.low: Becomes more methodical, more precise, more pleasant
stress_responses.medium: Stops asking questions; starts making statements phrased as questions
stress_responses.high: Sits very still for a long moment, then makes a decision and does not revisit it

contradictions: Claims his function is justice but works for an entity for which justice is a PR variable
Is rigorously honest and also rigorously strategic about what he volunteers
habits: Reads physical files rather than digital ones whenever possible
Takes the skybridge home regardless of weather
Writes the name before he's certain, then confirms — he finds it clarifying
breaking_points: Being directly ordered to close Case 32 without prosecution — that he would not survive intact

cyberware_inventory.name: Axiom subdermal employee compliance monitor — mandatory, tracks location/biometrics, HR-accessible
cyberware_inventory.description: Axiom subdermal employee compliance monitor — mandatory, tracks location/biometrics, HR-accessible

timeline.event: Age 29 — Joined Axiom Security Division as a compliance analyst
Age 37 — Transferred to Internal Affairs Branch following a divisional restructure
Age 37-51 — Prosecuted 31 officers for misconduct over 14 years
Age 50 — Submitted Case 32 prosecution package; file has not moved

physical_description.heritage: North African (41.4%) and Sub-Saharan African (31.3%) with significant Indigenous American (14.6%) and Middle Eastern (12.7%) ancestry. This creates a rich, complex blend of deep warm browns from dual African heritage, enriched by subtle copper and reddish undertones from Indigenous American ancestry, layered with Levantine warmth from Middle Eastern genetics. His features reflect this multiregional mosaic: strong, defined cheekbones carry both Saharan and Sub-Saharan African geometry, while his facial structure shows the subtle high-set cheekbones and slight width across the zygomatic arch characteristic of Indigenous American ancestry. Skin depth and undertone carry the warmth of North African and Levantine sun combined with Sub-Saharan richness.
physical_description.build: Lean and angular, almost ascetic—minimal soft tissue, all planes and edges. Shoulders slightly narrow for his height, suggesting a frame built for endurance rather than strength. Posture rigidly upright, the kind that comes from sitting in institutional chairs for decades.
physical_description.hair_color: Natural silver, fully gray-white without dye or treatment
physical_description.hair_style: Precisely cropped, almost military-neat, parted on the left. No styling product, just clean geometry.
physical_description.eye_color: Dark brown, natural, unremarkable—the kind of eyes that listen more than they judge
physical_description.skin_tone: Deep warm brown with subtle reddish-copper undertones, the result of North African (41.4%) and Sub-Saharan African (31.3%) dominance enriched by Indigenous American (14.6%) warmth and Middle Eastern (12.7%) golden complexity. Medium-deep saturation with luminous warm undertones that suggest ancestral connection to multiple continents. Even complexion that catches light with subtle warmth across the cheekbones.
physical_description.complexion: Strong, defined cheekbones with visible high-set geometry characteristic of blended African and Indigenous American ancestry, casting distinct shadows in overhead lighting. Zygomatic prominence suggests Indigenous American contribution. Thin lips, angular jaw with minimal softness. Facial structure reflects the geometric strength of North African and Sub-Saharan African features combined with the subtle width and prominence of Indigenous American cheekbones. Skin condition is immaculate—no scars, no blemishes, maintained with functional precision rather than vanity. Reading glasses worn on a thin silver chain despite not requiring optical correction; they sit low on the bridge of his nose when in use.
distinguishing_marks: Faint horizontal line across left wrist—old, surgical-clean scar approximately 4cm long, consistent with childhood injury or very precise medical intervention, barely visible unless noted
physical_description.visible_augmentations: None visible to casual observation. The Axiom subdermal compliance monitor sits beneath the left clavicle; a faint linear scar marks its insertion point, barely detectable under the collar of a dress shirt. No LED optics, no chrome, no industrial protrusions—a point of deliberate professional distinction.
physical_description.posture_movement: Moves with minimum wasted motion, each gesture economical and deliberate. Sits with perfect spinal alignment. Does not fidget. Hands rest flat on surfaces when not in use. Eye contact is steady and unblinking without being aggressive—the gaze of someone who has learned to make silence itself a form of communication. Walks slowly, as if each step is being catalogued.
physical_description.clothing_style: Tier 2 corporate formal—expensive but aggressively neutral. Gray wool slacks (tailored, no wrinkles), gray or pale blue dress shirts (100% cotton, changed daily), dark gray blazer or unstructured jacket (no logos, no visible branding). Minimal jewelry: simple silver watch, no rings. Shoes are black leather oxfords, always polished. A small grey Axiom Security Division pin on the lapel—mandatory, worn without pride or resentment. The overall effect is designed to be forgotten immediately after being observed, a walking beige monolith in a Tier 2 administrative corridor.
